mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, price, stock, created_at, updated_at FROM products ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products (name, description, price, stock) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{stock})
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODCUCTS SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, stock = #{stock} updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
